title: MC_Modernized
description: This modpack optimizes, modifies, and expands upon the vanilla game, adding perfectly integrated features and updating those that feel dated.
body:
# MC_Modernized is the ideal Minecraft experience. 

The goal isn't to stray too far from vanilla, adding around double the content of the base game. These expansions include:

### New Biomes 🌳

Get lost throughout all three dimensions, featuring mods like Enderscape, Cinderscapes, Wilder Wild, etc. 

### New & Revamped Structures 🏰

Scattered around the world, some friendly, some abandoned, and some occupied by foes to mess you up! 

### New & Revamped Mobs 🧟‍♂️

Inviting familiar faces with Friends & Foes, bringing life to Spiders with Web, and adding many variants of everything else.  

### Comforts 🛌

Excercise your cullinary expertise with Farmer's Delight until you get tired, and then sit down on a chair from Nemo's Carpentery to rest 

### Optimizations ⚡️

Experience Minecraft in real time with enhanced FPS from Sodium, Lithium and the like, as chunks load super fast thanks to CCME, and sounds and particles are fully optimized and atmospheric. 

### Shaders 🌄

Handpicked options to match the style of the modpack for different quality devices, but feel free to add your own!

### Multiplayer 👬👬👬

Built in multiplayer with Essential and supporting mods (disclaimer: i reccomend you steer clear of the microtransactions, but it's up to you)

### Much More

The rest, you'll have to find out on your own, my friend. Feel free to join the discord, and keep your eye out for updates in the main menu. Enjoy! ;)
